components.name: ArrangeableGrid
components.description: A fixed grid of slots, like an inventory: drag an item onto an empty slot to move it, onto a full one to swap (or stack, with `merge`). Link grids, drop targets and sources in an `ArrangeableGridRoot` to drag between them. Keyboard: arrows move focus, Enter or Space picks up and drops, Escape cancels, Delete removes when `removable`.

props.name: value
props.description: Slots in reading order. Shorter arrays are padded with empty slots.

props.name: getId
props.description: Stable key for an item, so its rendered state follows it between slots.

props.name: getItemLabel
props.description: Screen reader name for an item. Defaults to "item".

props.name: label
props.description: Screen reader name for the grid, e.g. "Backpack". Also names linked grids apart.

props.name: gridId
props.description: Needed to tell linked grids apart inside one `ArrangeableGridRoot`.

props.name: accept
props.type: ((item: T, index: number, from: ArrangeableGridLocation | null) => boolean)
props.description: Whether `index` takes `item`. `from` is where it comes from, or null when it comes from an `ArrangeableGridSource`. Swaps check both sides.

props.name: merge
props.description: Called when an item lands on an occupied slot. Return the combined item to stack them, e.g. adding counts; return null to swap instead.

props.name: removable
props.description: Dropping an item outside every grid and target, or pressing Delete on it, removes it.

props.name: onItemRemove
props.description: Called when an item leaves this grid by removal or onto a target.

props.name: onDropData
props.type: ((data: DataTransfer, index: number) => T | T[] | null)
props.description: Takes files or text dragged in from outside the page. Return the new item(s) to place from the slot they were dropped on, or null to refuse.

components.name: ArrangeableGridRoot
components.description: Links several `ArrangeableGrid`s, `ArrangeableGridTarget`s and `ArrangeableGridSource`s so items can be dragged between them. A grid used on its own makes its own root.

components.name: ArrangeableGridSource
components.description: A palette entry that drags new items into any linked grid.

props.name: create
props.description: Makes a fresh item each time one is dragged out, e.g. with a new id.

props.name: label
props.description: Screen reader name, e.g. "Add sword". Enter adds one to the first open slot.

components.name: ArrangeableGridTarget
components.description: A place to drop items that isn't a slot, such as a trash or sell button.

props.name: onItemDrop
props.description: Called with the item dropped here and where it came from.

props.name: remove
props.description: Takes the item out of its grid on drop. On by default, for trash-style targets.
